content.text: Nothing checked out for Saturday, Aug 8 for a 5- and 8-year-old, so I'd go with High Park. It's a hot, dry day, around 29 and no rain. Jamie Bell Adventure Playground is there, plus the wading pool and splash pads, and the free animal display with bison, llamas and peacocks. It's at Bloor St W and Parkside Dr. The water play is seasonal, so it's worth checking that the splash pads are running before you head over.
